description: 변경의 위험도 판정 — 높으면 사람 승인

risk.instructions: How risky is it to merge this code change without a human looking at it?
criteria: None: text, docs, or tests only
Low: isolated UI or logic change
Medium: shared code, APIs, or dependencies
High: authentication, payments, data deletion, schema migration, or infrastructure
Critical: security-sensitive change affecting production data or credentials

sensitive.instructions: Does the change touch authentication, authorization, payments, personal data, data deletion, database migrations, secrets, CI/CD, or deployment configuration?
